Routes & Middleware (`api.php`) **There is no `api.php`.** The only route files are: ```4:12:backend/routes/web.php // SPA fallback: serve frontend for all non-API routes Route::get('/{path?}', function () { $index = public_path('index.html'); if (!file_exists($index)) { return response()->json(['status' => 'ok', 'hint' => 'Run: cd frontend && npm run deploy']); } return response()->file($index); })->where('path', '^(?!api).*'); ``` The `bootstrap/app.php` registers `App\Providers\RouteServiceProvider` but that class file is missing from `app/Providers/`. This means the API routes are not formally registered in any discoverable file — they cannot be audited from the route definition layer. **The middleware system that would apply to routes if they existed:** ```9:29:backend/app/Http/Kernel.php protected $middlewareGroups = [ 'web' => [ \Illuminate\Routing\Middleware\SubstituteBindings::class, ], 'api' => [ \Illuminate\Routing\Middleware\SubstituteBindings::class, \App\Http\Middleware\AttachAuthUser::class, ], ]; protected $routeMiddleware = [ 'role' => \App\Http\Middleware\RequireRole::class, 'api_key' => \App\Http\Middleware\ApiKeyAuth::class, 'require_campus' => \App\Http\Middleware\RequireCampus::class, ]; ``` **Role resolution (`AttachAuthUser`):** Roles are determined from the DB `User.type` field: - `type = 'S'` → `super_admin` (cannot be overridden by header) - `type = 'T'` → `teacher` (overridable by `X-User-Role` header if value is `director` or `teacher`) - `type = 'U'` → `pending` - anything else (including `type = 'D'`) → `director` **`RequireRole` behaviour:** ```10:27:backend/app/Http/Middleware/RequireRole.php public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next, ...$roles) { $role = $request->attributes->get('auth_role'); if (!$role) { return response()->json(['message' => 'Unauthorized'], 401); } // Super admin bypasses all role checks if ($role === 'super_admin') { return $next($request); } if (!in_array($role, $roles, true)) { return response()->json(['message' => 'Forbidden'], 403); } return $next($request); } ``` `super_admin` bypasses all `role:` middleware. Directors and teachers are campus-scoped. --- ### 2. The `BackfillController` uses a `LearningRecord` model for backfill, but that is a separate endpoint. #### `student-classes` **Backend controller: does not exist.** `StudentClass` is used as a model within `SwipeRfidController`, `BackfillController`, and `PendingSwipeController`, but there is no dedicated `StudentClassController` with an `update` method or `confirmPayment` method. #### `schedules` No dedicated schedule controller exists. The `Schedule` model exists, and `ClassSession` is managed internally by other controllers. #### `attendance` **Controller exists** — `AttendanceController.php`. Role logic is applied **within the controller** (not via route middleware): - `index()`: `teacher` role → scoped to their own `TeacherID` only. All roles → scoped to their campus IDs. `super_admin` → no campus filter. - `store()` (manual attendance creation): `teacher` role → rejected with 403 if the class's `TeacherID` doesn't match their own. Campus check applied for non-super_admin. - `swipe()` (the attendance RFID path in this controller, separate from `SwipeRfidController`): uses `api_key` auth — authenticates the terminal device, not a user. **Critical gap — no session deduction on manual attendance:** ```266:278:backend/app/Http/Controllers/AttendanceController.php private function applyAttendanceEffects(ClassSession $classSession, string $status): void { $sessionStatus = match ($status) { 'present' => 'attended', 'late' => 'late', 'excused' => 'excused', 'absent' => 'absent', default => 'attended', }; $classSession->Status = $sessionStatus; $classSession->save(); } ``` `applyAttendanceEffects` only updates `ClassSession.Status`. It does **not** decrement `StudentClass.RemainingSessions`. In contrast, `SwipeRfidController.deductOnAttendance()` does deduct sessions. So: **RFID swipes deduct sessions; manual attendance entries do not.** #### `swipe-rfid` `SwipeRfidController.swipe()` — auth is campus Bearer token (from `Campus.Token` DB field), not a user JWT. Any device with the correct campus token can call this. There is no `role:` middleware on this route. **Deduction logic is here** (not in `AttendanceController`): ```272:291:backend/app/Http/Controllers/SwipeRfidController.php private function deductOnAttendance(StudentClass $sc, StudentSignIn $signIn): void { try { DB::transaction(function () use ($sc, $signIn) { $sc = StudentClass::where('ID', $sc->ID)->lockForUpdate()->first(); if (!$sc) return; $sc->UsedSessions = ($sc->UsedSessions ?? 0) + 1; $isSessionMode = ($sc->ScheduleMode === 'count' || (int) ($sc->SessionCount ?? 0) > 0); if ($isSessionMode) { $sc->RemainingSessions = max(0, (int) ($sc->RemainingSessions ?? 0) - 1); if ($sc->RemainingSessions <= 0) { $sc->Stop = 1; } ``` #### `pending-swipes` `PendingSwipeController` — no `role:` route middleware, but campus-scoped internally. `super_admin` sees all; others only their campus. No director-specific restriction found. #### `billing` `BillingController` — no role checks inside the controller methods. Whoever has access to the route can create invoices and record payments. Director-specific restriction would need to come from route middleware that isn't auditable (no `api.php`). #### `directors/*` `DirectorAccountController`: - `POST /api/v1/directors/register` — public (no auth) - `GET /api/v1/directors/pending` — inline `super_admin` only check - `POST /api/v1/directors/{id}/approve` — inline `super_admin` only - `POST /api/v1/directors/{id}/reject` — inline `super_admin` only --- ### 3. `StudentClassController` — `update` and `confirmPayment` **This file does not exist.** There is no `StudentClassController.php` anywhere in the backend. The methods `update` (line 604+) and `confirmPayment` cannot be audited. --- ### 4. `LearningRecordsPage.vue` — Role Checks & Edit Button The active frontend (`/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/`) does **not** contain this file. The audit is from `temp_build/src/pages/LearningRecordsPage.vue` and `frontend_build/src/pages/LearningRecordsPage.vue` — both are identical. **There is no separate "edit" button.** The table only has a "檢視" (view) button for all records, plus conditional approve/reject buttons: ```86:90:frontend_build/src/pages/LearningRecordsPage.vue ``` Clicking "檢視" opens the modal, which becomes editable (`isEditing=true`) unless the record is `approved` (which triggers `isReadOnly=true`). The edit controls in the modal are gated only by `isReadOnly`, not by role. **`canApprove` — the critical role check:** ```464:467:frontend_build/src/pages/LearningRecordsPage.vue const canApprove = (record) => { if (props.userRole !== 'director' && props.userRole !== 'admin') return false; return record.Status === 'pending'; }; ``` **Bug:** The valid system roles are `super_admin`, `director`, `teacher`, and `pending`. The string `'admin'` is **not a real role**. `super_admin` is not included in this check — so a super admin user will see `false` for `canApprove` and will not see the approve/reject buttons. **Teacher filter — director-only:** ```28:35:frontend_build/src/pages/LearningRecordsPage.vue
``` Super admins also cannot see the teacher filter — same gap. **`isDirectorOrSuperAdmin` — not present.** The file uses no such computed or helper. There is only the single `userRole === 'director'` check for the filter and the `canApprove` check above. --- ### 5.
